messages:
Priya: starting migration: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_tenant ON events ((metadata->>'tenant_id')) WHERE archived = false. Canary on 4 hosts. DeployBot queued the job.
DeployBot: deployment 2135790001: migration 'idx_events_tenant' started (canary-4).
Eli: quick note: this hits large scans on some shards. setting backfill_rate=40 and parallel_workers=2 for canary.
Sam: telemetry: canary-db-2 shows lock wait p99 ~2.4s during index finalize. CPU +25% on primaries. tagging @eng-sre.
eng-sre-bot: alert: cross-region replicas showing lock wait spike correlated with index commit phase. p99 up to 4.1s. Recommend pause ramp and reduce parallel_workers to 1.
Priya: pausing ramp. updating parallel_workers=1 and applying canary-only autovacuum pause for affected shards.
DeployBot: config update applied: parallel_workers=1, backfill_rate=40, canary_autovacuum_pause=true.
DB-Ops: will pause autovacuum on shards 02 and 05 on canary nodes only.
Sam: after change, canary lock waits dropped to p99 ~1.0s, but non-canary primaries still show intermittent spikes.
Priya: given cross-region impact, aborting rollout and invoking rollback plan 'concurrent-index-abort'. rollback command: ./deploy rollback --id 2135790001 --target-tag stable-202608
DeployBot: rollback initiated. index cancellation signaled; note: CONCURRENT builds may leave temporary index artifacts.
DB-Ops: will scan for partial indexes and clean up with DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY if safe. will coordinate kills only if locks exceed 6m.
DocsBot: release note updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/2135790001 (status: aborted).
Priya: action items: (1) add preflight for autovacuum frequency, (2) default parallel_workers=1 for CONCURRENT builds, (3) add conservative cross-region lock check in preflight. scheduling postmortem. thanks team. :thumbsup:
